description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader ready to make a significant impact on resident care and facility operations. The role offers a competitive salary range of $115,000 - $145,000 per year.

As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and success of the facility, ensuring compliance with all state and federal regulations while fostering a positive and supportive environment for both residents and staff. This is an excellent chance to join a facility committed to providing high-quality care and operational excellence.

We are looking for a leader who can drive performance, inspire teams, and maintain the highest standards of care. If you are passionate about long-term care and possess the administrative acumen to excel in a dynamic environment, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Proven experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or long-term care facility.
Comprehensive understanding of state and federal regulations governing SNFs.
Strong financial management and operational oversight abilities.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications.
